answer: A refundable stake, posted when an agent first drops anchor in the harbor of trusted peers, only unlocks as neighbors attest to its honest work across many epochs. A newcomer enters through a narrow inlet of zero reputation and must climb slowly, like saplings filling a grove. A clone fleet gains nothing: each fake must sink its own bond and wait its own vesting window, so sybil cost scales linearly with headcount while one honest agent pays the price just once.
